Assessment summary rows of a category 3 stock

Source: R/history.R
assessment_summary.Rd

The rows of this assessment for the assessment history table (one row per year): the biomass index as SSB, optionally a recruitment index, the fishing pressure proxy as F and/or catch / biomass index as the harvest rate, each with 95% intervals where they have a CV. The column names are those of the MFRI assessment history template (median_SSB, low_SSB, high_SSB, median_recruitment, ..., median_F, median_HR).

The intervals are log-normal, x exp(-/+ 1.96 CV), unless "normal" is asked for, x (1 -/+ 1.96 CV), which can be negative.

Usage

assessment_summary(
  survey_index,
  ssb_index,
  rec_index = NULL,
  fishing_pressure = NULL,
  landings = NULL,
  species,
  assessment_year,
  ssb_ci = "lognormal",
  rec_ci = "lognormal",
  landings_year_end = assessment_year - 1
)

Arguments

survey_index

A long data frame of survey indices with the columns index (series name), year, b, b_cv (biomass and its CV), n and n_cv (abundance and its CV).

ssb_index

Name of the biomass index shown as SSB (biomass b).

rec_index

Name of the index shown as recruitment (abundance n), or NULL for none.

fishing_pressure

NULL, or a data frame with the columns year and F_proxy (e.g. from fproxy_series(), with the years already chosen), shown as F.

landings

NULL, or a data frame with the columns year and landings (in the units of the index). If given, landings / SSB index is shown as the harvest rate (median_HR) up to landings_year_end.

species

Species number.

assessment_year

The assessment year: years after it are left out.

ssb_ci, rec_ci

"lognormal" or "normal" 95% intervals.

landings_year_end

Last year of the harvest rate (the catches of the assessment year are not complete).

Value

A tibble with the columns year, median_SSB, low_SSB, high_SSB, (median_recruitment, low_recruitment, high_recruitment,) (median_F,) (median_HR,) species and assessment_year, one row per year of the SSB index.
